Roadmap and step -by -step plan to start a doctorate at Ghent university
In order to start a doctorate at Ghent University in a smooth way, a step-by-step plan was developed for PhD candidates. They
can go through this plan at there own pace. Hereby the PHD candidate receives tailor-made information at a time in which the
information provided is the most relevant. Both the promoter and PhD candidate always have a good view of the phase in
which the PhD candidate is in their journey to Ghent University. All steps to be taken can be found clearly via the PHD Roadmap
at the webpage of Ghent University. This roadmap is part of the Lifecycle@Ghent University and gives a visual overview of all
the phases an international PhD candidate goes through - from the ﬁrst preparation to the welcome at Ghent University. Below
is a written explanation with all necessary steps and useful links.
Prior to initiating the step-by-step, it is essential to know that as a PhD candidate you can be registered at Ghent University
under different status. Knowing your status is important to smoothly register at Ghent University. All PhD candidates have to
be registered as PhD students.
Phase 1 and 2: Pre-registration and registration
The pre-registration and registration phase helps in determining under which status you, as a PhD candidate, will join Ghent
University:
• Full or degree seeking PhD Candidate: You register and aim to obtain a doctoral diploma at Ghent University.
o You pay an enrolment fee and often also a bench fee.
o Make sure you have sufﬁcient ﬁnancial resources.
o Depending on your funding source you will only be registered as a doctoral student or also as a
Scholarship Holder or Employee. In doubt: ask your promoter.
In this phase of the step-by-step plan of a full or degree seeking PhD candidate, you will also receive more
information on research topics, promotors, funding sources and opportunities before being guided to the actual
registration process.
Steps to take:
1. Deﬁne a research topic via UGent Research Explorer.
2. Find an UGent promoter via the researchers database.
3. Search for funding for your PhD.
4. Get registered.
• Exchange of Visiting PhD Candidate: You remain a student at your home institution but perform (part of) your
research in Ghent.
Steps to take:
1. Get in touch with a UGent researcher via the researchers database.
2. Get registered.
Phase 3 and 4: Pre-enrolment and enrolment
After the pre-registration and registration phase you can start the next steps in your journey to Ghent University. This
includes practical and administrative steps. Notice that depending on your status the steps to take might differ.
 Full or degree seeking PhD Candidate
Deﬁne your status. In doubt ask advice from your promoter. We kindly offer you tailormade information on banking,
cost of living, enrolment, health care, housing, insurance, visa and preparing your stay.
More information for:
o PhD candidate only
o PhD candidate and Ghent University scholarship holder
o PhD candidate and employee
 Exchange of Visiting PhD Candidate
We kindly offer you tailormade information on banking, cost of living, enrolment, health care, housing, insurance,
visa and preparing your stay.
Phase 5: Pre-arrival
After completing phases 1 to 4, this phase will help you in preparing your travel and the ﬁrst working day. Depending on your
status the checklist might be different. Checklist for preparing your stay as:
 a Full or degree seeking PhD Candidate
 an Exchange or Visiting PhD Candidate
Contact & Support
Do you have questions or do you doubt which phase you are in? Contact Doctoral School. Always state your name, your
promoter and the phase of the roadmap you are in.
More background info: Roadmap International Researchers Guide.
